name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Cedarmere goes with exactly two of Cody, Perch, and Jig.
Between Bass and Perch, one goes with Grayreach and the other with Mossbank.
Grayreach goes with at least two of Dale, Bass, and Jig.
The angler at Grayreach and Royce are in different families.
Exactly one of these is true: Dale goes with Spinnerbait; Bluegill goes with Buzzbait; Perch goes with Mossbank.
Mossbank goes with either Pike or Spoon (but not both).
Either Cody belongs to the Sunfish Family or both members of the North Watershed belong to the Sunfish Family (but not both).

hints.text: Suppose Bass went with Birchpool — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.

So Bass does not go with Birchpool.
